name: Ripe For Trouble
description: Time to look for Tisoc, the missing guard...

steps.description: Enter the cavern and look for Tisoc, who has gone missing
Check on the person who has collapsed
Explore the roots of the Flamegranate Tree
Find a way to increase the Liquid Phlogiston levels
Explore the roots of the Flamegranate Tree
Go to the lower levels of the Flamegranate's roots
Go to the lower levels of the Flamegranate's roots
Go to the lower levels of the Flamegranate's roots

dialogs.content: Hey there, you two! Now, I can see the hot blood running in your veins as you rush into yonder cave, but stop there for a minute.
Your attire tells me you're not from our tribe, the Scions of the Canopy... Heh, who am I kidding? You aren't from Natlan at all, are you?
What's up with that? Are only people from Natlan allowed in?
That goes without saying! But even then, not just anyone from our tribe can go in, let alone people from Natlan as a whole...
*sigh* Well, you're pretty quick on the uptake for a flying kid with shaggy hair.
Hmph, of course, Paimon's a bright spark... Wait, are you saying she doesn't look like it?
That's certainly how you strike me, Paimon!
Yeah, it's just... exactly that! You get me, don'cha, my outlander friend?
What are you two talking about? Are you... complimenting Paimon? Hmm, doesn't quite seem like it...
You can consider it praise, of course! Anyway... Name's Tisoc, and I'm the guard here — and an excellent one, at that.
#Well, Paimon's Paimon — as good a guide as you are a guard — and this is {NICKNAME}...
Most excellent of adventurers, at your service!
I see. An adventurer, huh? Makes sense. Doubt any ordinary traveler could find this spot anyway.
Ah! But anyway, I can't let you in. It is, after all, where our tribe produces our Flamegranates — real important business.
Wait, what's so special about that? You find those everywhere here in Natlan!
Ah, see that's where you'd be mistaken. If you pick them using a special technique, not only will they not explode, but they'll produce honey as rich in phlogiston as Quenepa Berries!
Dry the skins, and you can even get bags that our Couriers can carry. *sigh* Though you outlanders wouldn't get the beauty of something like this.
Huh, so that's what those round sacks are made from...
That's right. What's more, this cave is home to awesome Mountain King Flamegranates... Which makes me, the one who guards them, just as awesome.

That said, the Mountain King Flamegranates have recently been... Eh, forget it. Whatever the case, unless you've got one of those green passes that rustle when you rub 'em, I'm not letting you through.
Can't we even sneak a peek?
Not even that — not even people from our tribe are allowed in without a pass...
And speaking of that, I heard <color=#00E1FFFF>someone lost theirs</color> a few days back. Couldn't find it either... Man, did Wayna chew them out.
Oops. Seems I've said more than I should.
Anyway, no entry without a pass, y'hear?
Formidable Guard Slayer, at your service!
Really? Are you a "Formidable Guard" Slayer, or a Formidable "Guard Slayer," in that case?
Either way... *sigh* Does that mean I'm facing some sort of dangerous person right now?
#Nah, {M#he's}{F#she's} just talking nonsense! And even if {M#he}{F#she} were to slay any guards, they'd be "Ruin Guards"!
Oh, this is bad. This is bad... Tisoc... Has something happened to him?
Should I go in and take a look? Ugh, but if that guy catches me, I'm going to get another earful... *sigh*
Who might you be?
I—I—I'm Poca, a Courier here in the tribe. I—I'll have you know I even earned the title of Best Courier the year before last... It's the truth, you can check for yourself!
...Wait a minute. I'm supposed to be the one asking these questions. I mean, I'm a Scion of the Canopy, aren't I!? So, who are you then? You're not even from Natlan, are you?
Hmph, doesn't matter who you are or where you're from — the skittish types always look more suspicious...
Yeah, so I've been told... "Chin up and chest out, Poca!" But if you ask me, back-bent and careful-on-your-feet works better for my line of work.
A—Anyway, who are you two...
You introduce yourselves to Poca...
Ah, I see. So you're travelers from afar...
*sigh* I'm likely not supposed to tell you this, but this cave is the site of the Mother Flamegranate Tree's roots, which our tribe's always guarded.
Special "Mountain King Flamegranates" also grow there, making this a very, very important spot.
That's why my friend, the serious Tisoc, guards this spot. And while it's not good to speak ill of people behind their backs, I reckon he's almost too serious!
He bars the way here every day, and gets super mad if anyone tries to sneak past... That hasn't made him the most popular fella in our tribe.
Heh, not that I dislike him for it... But either way, he's not here today, and I've been waiting a while... A worrying sign.
Why don't you go in and have a look yourself?
No, I couldn't! You need a pass to get in — you know those green-edged slips of paper? Those are the ones! And I don't have one...
They aren't easy to get your hands on, and strictly controlled too. I heard that someone lost one a couple of days ago, and Wayna gave them a real earful.
#(Hmm, that's weird. She seems to be describing that item we found... Why don't we show it to her, {NICKNAME}?)
Might this be the pass you're talking about...
Ah, that is indeed the pass. Hmm... Ugh, you've put me in a tough spot now.
Tough spot... Why? We can just give it to you, and then, boom — not only do you have a pass, but you can even go in and check on your friend...
*sigh* S'not that simple. Having one won't stop Tisoc from lecturing me...
And why's that?
Well, just think, little Paimon! These passes are usually given to those who can do long-term guard duty, but I'm just a tribe Courier...
Who runs to and fro every day...
Exactly. So if I went in, I'd be exposed right away. In theory, anyone who sees something that belongs to the tribe should have it retrieved... But I can't use it.
Ah, so that's it. In that case, we'd have just snuck in without showing you the pass at all!
Well, that's what makes things tough on me... How about this? I'm just going to pretend you're not here, like a Yumkasaurus with its eyes closed...
And could I trouble you to go in and have a look in my stead? Tisoc's serious, but he's not the brightest. Just say you got a pass from our chief. What do you say?
Of course, I'll be sure to reward you. In fact, I'd be glad to help someone who helped me and even retrieved one of our passes.
#Huh, y'know, {NICKNAME}... If Tisoc's not hurt, we'll get paid just for having a walk down there. Nifty, huh?
Alright, we'll go in and have a look.
In that case, I'll be up here under the Mother Flamegranate Tree, waiting for you, alright?
(Display the green piece of paper...)
Your name, please!
Why, that Tisoc, worrying me like this... But anyway, I'm quite curious as to what he's been hiding lately...
Hey, hey! Wake up! You okay?
Ugh... I... H—Have I been called to the Night Kingdom already? I believe I see a floating person...
Huh? Wait. Let me have a closer look at you... You're Paimon!
That's right! It's Paimon, most excellent Paimon!
*sigh* Thank you both so much. I was coming down here to check on things, but I wound up fainting... Perhaps the abnormal environment here has caused a drastic change in temperature...
N—No, wait. First off, how did you get in here without a pass?
#Oh, we've got one. C'mon, {NICKNAME}, show him. That'll teach him to let passes pass, but not people!
This is what you're looking for, I believe...
Hmm... Yes, this is one of our passes.
I didn't expect to see it in the hands of an outlander. That's quite novel... But rather strange all the same.
Why? Is this the wrong pass?
Right pass, wrong people. In truth, the green patterns on the side of the pass have names hidden in them... and this should be the one that was lost a few days ago.
...Let me guess. You found the pass and came here. In which case, the most sensible thing to have done in my absence would have been to send this back to our tribe.
But you chose to come down here instead... Did someone instruct you to, then? And since they knew about the passes, but not all the details... A Courier, then?
What the... You do know your stuff after all! And Poca told us you were some overly serious, stubborn, thick-headed... Err, oops.
Oh, her, was it? Good. Then I know who to settle the score with once I get back up.
Ack, slip of the tongue... But still, she only asked us to come down here because she was concerned about you!
Oh really? I'd say she did it on purpose... *sigh* Didn't think she'd figure me out despite my efforts to hide it...
Still, she did send me an outlander unrelated to tribal affairs, like delivering a pillow to someone about to doze off.
Well then, brave warriors! Could you hear me out? I've a request I can't tell the rest of the tribe about. I'd preferred to have solved this myself...
But as you can see, I ended up lying on the ground here.
Yeah, you're just a guard. Why do you have to investigate this cave too?
Actually... *sigh* It's the Mountain King Flamegranates. Here's one of them right here — the best of the best, both in terms of size and phlogiston content.
It's just that they were supposed to ripen over the last two days... and yet, as you can see, they're still all green and blue. No signs of maturing at all.
As their names suggest, they are to be offered to the Mountain King, and their importance needs no words to explain.
Also, this isn't just about the Mountain King Flamegranates... Most of the fruit grown on the Mother Tree amidst the cliffs are also "green" as can be.
I've taken care of them for so many years. How could I not tell that something had gone wrong with the roots?
You could've just told the others in your tribe!
Pah. No one knows Flamegranate Trees better than I do, that much I can guarantee. In other words, if I can't solve the issue...

...Forget it. If I really can't solve this, I'll simply admit defeat and have people from either the Masters of the Night-Wind or the Collective of Plenty take a look. But before that, I'd like to give this a shot.
It will, however, be difficult to pull off on my own, so... Well, you are brave outlander warriors, are you not...?
Well, we could help you, it's just that...
...Hah. I'll bet Poca sent you down here with promises of payment or something, yes?
Well, if we solve our Flamegranate Tree problem, I'll have her contribute a greater share.
Wait, why her...
Hey now, she's a Courier. More capable by far of paying than someone on a fixed salary like me!
And anyway, she's the one who persuaded two outlanders to enter our taboo grounds, just so she could find out what's going on — there's gotta be a "cost" to that, right?
Shouldn't it be you instead?
(Display the green piece of paper...)
Ach, as expected, this spot is completely blocked off... That said, I found what's causing the temperature change a moment ago.
And as I thought, it's because there's this... solidified lava blocking the airflow.
So what do we do, then?
We could negotiate with it...
Bold of you to think it's capable of bargaining at all! Why don't we find some other way to get it to "clear out"!?
We could just blow it up!
That could work — there's certainly more than enough fruit around here to cause a great big boom.
Hey, hey, Tisoc! Wake up! Are you alright?
Ugh... I... H—Have I been called to the Night Kingdom already? I believe I see a floating person...
Huh? Wait, no, these are the roots of the Flamegranate Tree... Bah, and here I thought I'd gone to the Night Kingdom already.
Well, you might certainly have ended up in a faraway place, had we not come down to have a look...
Th—Thank you so much. I wanted to come down and check things out, but the temperature changed drastically for some reason... and I collapsed.
N—No, wait, hang on. First off, how did you get in here without a pass?

This is what you're looking for, I believe...

Sorry, could I get your names...

(Display the green piece of paper...)
Uh oh, the lava's rising! The roots of the Flamegranate Tree are glowing where they meet with the lava...
Ah, now this should be the normal look of things... Flamegranate Trees truly are mysterious.
When I followed my father around as a little lad, it was witnessing this scene that convinced me that I must take care of the trees as he did...
Will this allow the Flamegranates to mature?
That's right. Not only that, but with your help, these ones have been stocked full of absorbed phlogiston. They'll make for the best Flamegranates ever... Huh?
Is that an earthquake!? N—No, wait, the lava's rising! C'mon, run! To the high ground!
Th—That was way too scary! What in the world happened back there? That lava just came bubbling out from underground like sludge...
*pants* Let me catch my breath for a bit... I think blowing the rocks up might have been too much agitation for the lava.
Still, you sure it won't be a problem that it surged up so high? Y'know, when a withered flower sucks in too much water...
Well, that's a... good point, but at the same time, the Liquid Phlogiston levels will drop slowly until it becomes stable, just as before.
That said, thanks to that... Look, you two! Look at the Mountain King Flamegranates' color...
Let's take a closer look, shall we?
Wow, such perfect coloration.
Whoa!
No longer is this "green"...
Ah, just the sight of it's enough to make you feel warm... Perhaps we'll be able to pick them after a few more days of observation.
The Mountain King's not been in the best shape in recent years. If it eats this fruit, things might take a turn for the better...
Either way, I can't thank you enough. This... isn't much, but take it as a token of my gratitude.
Hehe, we'll take it gladly, then. Wait, didn't you say you'd have Poca fork out the lion's share?
Haha, I was kidding. What's hers is hers, and what's mine is mine. We're not so close that I could bill her for helping me out.
But well, what did I say? I'm the Flamegranate expert, aren't I?
Hehe, guess you're an excellent expert, on top of being a great guard!
Alright then. Let's head back up, and try not to faint this time!
That won't happen so easily now since things have stabilized here... But anyway, the pass, please. It's an important item as far as our tribe's concerned, after all...
Ah, right. But what if we wanna swing by again?
If you're just swinging by to have another look around—
I'm just going to have to keep one eye closed, just as a Yumkasaurus might.
But a "ripe orange"!
Wow, this is amazing! Such thick roots — and they're not burning despite being so close to the lava!
Of course. The roots of the Flamegranate Tree not only endure proximity to Liquid Phlogiston — their fibers can even absorb it and grow as a result.
...As such, being "close to lava" isn't the normal state. The roots should really be "immersed in lava."
Seems like the issue's with the lava's surface... The entire root system's temperature has gone down. That's how lava that should never have cooled or piled up now blocks our way...
So we just need to get the <color=#00E1FFFF>lava level to rise</color>, right?
Well, if you could grow to prodigious size and sit in the lava, Paimon...
No way! That sounds super hot!
#You're talking nonsense again, aren't you, {NICKNAME}... Still, if we must make the lava rise...
Look, over there. The issue's just that the lava outlet's been blocked.
Ah, Paimon gets it. All we need to do is blast that lava rock away, and the lava behind will... Wait, won't we be swallowed up by the surging tide once that happens?
Hmm... That's a good point, Paimon. Let's see if we can find another way...
Quick, Paimon, vomit the food you ate into the pool of...
That won't raise the lava one bit! It'll swallow all that food — and at that point, it might as well stay in Paimon's stomach.
*sigh* Whatever will we do about the Mountain King Flamegranates— Wait, hey! Stop! I told you before — no passage without a pass...
I mean, take <color=#00E1FFFF>the fella in our tribe</color> who lost his pass for example. I've known him a long time, but I can't let him pass either... Rules are rules. That's all there is to it.
Th—That was way too scary! What in the world happened back there? That lava just came bubbling out from underground like sludge...
#Good thing Paimon clung onto you, {NICKNAME}, or you might've fallen right in!
Maybe fly me to safety next time?
Thought I'd lose my legs for a moment back there!
Hmph, don't get ahead of yourself. That'd be way too tiring!
R—Right! C'mon, let Paimon have a look at you... Looks like they're in one piece. There, there, don't worry...
